name: General Topological Spaces
assumptions: X is an arbitrary topological space (X, \tau)

name: T1 Topological Spaces
assumptions: Singletons {x} are closed in X (T1 axiom)

name: Hausdorff (T2) Spaces
assumptions: Distinct points have disjoint neighborhoods (T2 axiom)

name: Metrizable Spaces
assumptions: The topology of X is induced by a metric d: X \times X \to [0, \infty)
